rationale: C08 is an exceptionally close drafting template: it uses the same two-recital sequence, nearly verbatim language, the same retirement statute and exemption mechanism, and the same timing structure, with only the official, commission, and year changed. C13 and C18 also exhibit essentially the same machinery, but C08 is closest because its subject is likewise a member of an independent federal commission becoming retirement-eligible in January.

shared_material.child_excerpt: William E. Lee, a member of the Interstate Commerce Commission, will, during the month of January 1952, become subject to compulsory retirement for age under the provisions of the Civil Service Retirement Act of May 29, 1930 as amended, unless exempted therefrom by Executive order
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Paul A. Walker, a member of the Federal Communications Commission, will, during the month of January 1951, become subject to compulsory retirement for age under the provisions of the Civil Service Retirement Act of May 29, 1930, as amended, unless exempted therefrom by Executive order
shared_material.explanation: The factual recital has the same distinctive syntax and legal formulation, adapted only to a different commissioner and year.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that the said person be exempted from such compulsory retirement as provided below: NOW, THEREFORE
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that the said person be exempted from such compulsory retirement as provided below: NOW, THEREFORE
shared_material.explanation: The second recital and transition into the operative portion are verbatim, confirming a shared literal drafting template.
